title: Ecological niche models for the plants of Europe
text: ENMs adhere Hutchinsonian conceptualisation ecological niche n-dimensional hypervolume (Hutchinson, 1957). environmental variables forming dimensions hypervolume consist : M - Soil Moisture1 R - Reaction1 N - Soil Nitrogen1 L - Light1 GP - Grazing Pressure2 SD - Soil Disturbance2 S - Salinity3 tmin_wt - Minimum Winter Temperature4 tmax_sm - Maximum Summer Temperature4 prec_wt - Winter Precipitation4 prec_sm - Summer Precipitation4 Support Vector Machine (SVM) models, form hyperplane presence absence hypervolumes, trained tested using using mlr3 ecosystem R packages (Lang et al., 2019). raw e1071 (Meyer et al., 2024) SVM models bundled elements. information please see Marshall et al (prep). 1(Dengler et al., 2023), 2(Midolo et al., 2023), 3(Tichy et al., 2023), 4(Marchi et al., 2020)
